definitions.source: console_records(collection='exams') merged with examinations; assignments from console_records(collection='candidates') and exam_student_assignments.
definitions.calculation: One row per distinct exam id. The console record wins for the same id. startAt falls back to the earliest exam_schedules.start_time. assigned uses the console candidate count when present, otherwise the normalized assignment count.
definitions.inclusion: Every exam visible in the caller's tenant scope, including draft and cancelled exams.
definitions.exclusion: Exams without a tenant identifier are excluded unless the caller has global scope. Duplicate rows with the same id collapse to the console copy.
